title: Eye Contact
content: Make eye contact with your baby at 20-30 cm distance

title: Sound Games
content: Make soft sounds, baby is learning to recognize voices

title: Tummy Time
content: Place baby on tummy for 3-5 minutes daily

title: Grasping Objects
content: Develop grasping skills with colorful toys

title: Reading Books
content: Show picture books, helps language development

title: Music
content: Sing children songs, develops sense of rhythm

title: Speech
content: Repeat simple words, speeds up language development
